limits.deadlineScope: Child execution is polled; group deadline is also checked after validation. Synchronous filesystem/system calls can delay a check, so this is not a hard end-to-end I/O timeout.

method: Independently re-read and hashed all 84 candidate envelope/verification/manifest/source-inventory metadata files plus all21 logs; recalculated inventory counts/bytes and inspected archive path/size. Authenticated original canonical reports provide double-build and actual ZIP member admission. Held HEAD checked before/after; current source policy/helper pins match.
limitations: Archive bodies remain external and were not reread during this audit; their full hashes/member verification were measured by the completed canonical children.
Company runtime capacity is separate from source archive size; larger Company source archives are not misreported as runtime budget failures.
Successful polled execution/cleanup is not a hard wall-clock guarantee for synchronous SMB I/O.
No combined release envelope, publication, deployment, hosted Linux replay or physical/human acceptance is claimed.
